lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/أ/ل   s–ʾ–l asking, inquiring, requesting, quest.

Of this root, 9 forms occur 127 times in the Qur’an:
سَأَلَ saʾala 85 times; سُئلَ suʾila 19 times; تَسَاءَلُون tasāʾalūn 9 times; سُؤْل suʾl 1 time; سُؤَال suʾāl 1 time;سَائِل sāʾil 4 times; سائلين sāʾilın 3 times; مَسْئُول masʾūl 4 times and مَسْئُولُون masʾūlūn 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سَأَلَ saʾala a I [v. trans.; imper. إسْأَل ʾisʾal and سَلْ sal; pass. v. سُئلَ suʾila]

1 to ask

(29:63) وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً and if you ask them, ‘Who sends water down from the sky’

2 to question, to interrogate

(21:63) قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَذَا فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ إِنْ كَانُوا يَنْطِقُونَ he said, ‘No, it was this great one of them that did it–question them, if they can talk’

3 [with prep. عَن] a) to inquire after, to seek information of

(33:20) يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَنْبَائِكُمْ seeking news of you b) to query, to seek clarification

(18:76) قَالَ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلاَ تُصَاحِبْنِي he said, ‘If I query anything after it [this], do not keep company with me’ c) to seek advice, to seek guidance

(2:219) يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ they ask you [Prophet] about intoxicants and gambling d) to be taken to task, to be called to account

(16:93) وَلَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ you will certainly be called to account for your deeds; *‏

(21:23) لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ He is His own master [lit. He is not called to account for what He does]; *

(2:119) وَلاَ تُسْأَلُ عَنْ أَصْحَابِ الْجَحِيمِ [Prophet] You will not be responsible for [lit. questioned about] the inhabitants of the Blaze; *

(28:78) وَلاَ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ ذُنُوبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ it is of no avail to question the sinners about their sins [lit. the sinners will not be questioned about their sins]

4 [with prep. ﺒ] to demand, to urge

(70:1) سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ a man [mockingly] demanded the coming of [the threatened] punishment ‏II [doubly trans.] to ask someone for something, to beg

(20:132) لاَ نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ We do not ask of you any provision; We provide for you.

سُؤل suʾl [n./v. n.] request

(20:36) قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَامُوسَى He said, ‘You have been granted your request, Moses.’

entries.label: مَسئول
entries.definitionHtml:
مَسئول masʾūl [pass. part.]

1 one who is questioned, interrogated

(37:24) وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ and halt them, for they are to be questioned

2 [something] exacted, honoured; to be accounted for, to be answered for

(33:15) وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لاَ يُوَلُّونَ الأَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّهِ مَسْئُولا yet they had previously made an agreement with God that they would not turn tail and flee, and an agreement with God shall be exacted.

entries.label: يتسألون
entries.definitionHtml:
يتسألون yatasāʾlūn [imperf. of v. VI; intrans.]

1 to question one another

(18:19) وَكَذَلِكَ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِيَتَسَاءَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ and thus We woke them, so that they question one another

2 to request things from one another

(4:1) وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ be mindful of God, in whose name you make requests of one another.
